biological.citation: Zhang et al. 2021 - TAOK1 is associated with neurodevelopmental disorder and essential for neuronal maturation and cortical development (PMID: 33565190)
biological.summary: A cohort of 23 individuals with mostly de novo TAOK1 variants (largely truncating, plus missense) has a neurodevelopmental disorder. Altered TAOK1 levels in embryonic mouse brain disrupt neural migration in vivo and neuronal maturation in vitro. Missense variants act through loss of function or dominant-negative effects.

biological.citation: TAOK1 positively regulates TLR4-induced inflammatory responses by promoting ERK1/2 activation in macrophages (PMID: 32344244)
biological.summary: TAOK1 constitutively interacts with TRAF6 and TPL2 to promote LPS-induced ERK1/2 activation and IL-6, TNF-α and IL12p40 production in macrophages. TAOK1-deficient mice are less susceptible to endotoxin shock and make fewer pro-inflammatory cytokines.

biological.citation: TAOK1 negatively regulates IL-17-mediated signaling and inflammation (PMID: 29400705)
biological.summary: TAOK1 binds IL-17RA independently of its kinase activity and blocks formation of the IL-17R-Act1 complex, thereby dampening MAPK and NF-κB activation. TAOK1 deficiency worsens TNBS-induced colitis in mice, and TAOK1 expression is reduced in colons of ulcerative colitis patients.

biological.citation: Ste20-Like Kinase TAOK1 Positively Regulates Antiviral Responses by Controlling the TBK1-IRF3 Signaling Axis (PMID: 36649698)
biological.summary: TAOK1 associates constitutively with TBK1 independently of MAVS and promotes TBK1-IRF3 complex formation in a kinase-dependent manner. On viral infection TAOK1 switches from MAP4 to dynein, trafficking TBK1 along microtubules to bind IRF3. Virus infection downregulates TAOK1, and TAOK1 deficiency reduces type I IFN production and increases susceptibility to infection.

biological.citation: Oxaloacetate sensing promotes innate immune antiviral defence against influenza virus infection (PMID: 40983701)
biological.summary: TAOK1 phosphorylates the transcription factor ETS2 at serine 313 after ETS2 is recruited by an OAA-sensing MDH1 dimer scaffold. Phosphorylated ETS2 enters the nucleus and supports TBK1 expression and type I interferon responses against influenza.

biological.citation: TAOK1 promotes filament formation in HR repair through phosphorylating USP7 (PMID: 40106350)
biological.summary: A kinase inhibitor screen found TAOK1 synthetic lethal with PARP inhibitors. TAOK1 phosphorylates USP7, enhancing its activity and protecting RAD51 from ubiquitylation and degradation, which supports HR repair. TAOK1 depletion or inhibition causes RAD51 loss, impaired HR and PARPi sensitivity in cancer cells.

biological.citation: Thousand and one amino acid protein kinase 1 suppression improves doxorubicin-induced cardiomyopathy by preventing cardiomyocyte death and dysfunction (PMID: 39964965)
biological.summary: A kinome-wide CRISPR knockout screen in hPSC-derived cardiomyocytes identified TAOK1 as a regulator of doxorubicin-induced cell death. TAOK1 knockout or knockdown reduced DNA damage, mitochondrial dysfunction and p38 MAPK activation, while overexpression worsened death. AAV-mediated TAOK1 silencing protected the heart in a mouse model of doxorubicin cardiomyopathy.

biological.citation: Silencing of STE20-type kinase TAOK1 confers protection against hepatocellular lipotoxicity through metabolic rewiring (PMID: 36930872)
biological.summary: TAOK1 mRNA in human liver biopsies correlates positively with steatosis, inflammation and ballooning. TAOK1 protein colocalizes with lipid droplets in human and mouse hepatocytes. Silencing it enhanced lipid catabolism, reduced lipogenesis and ER/oxidative stress, and lowered ERK/JNK activation and ACC abundance.

biological.citation: Targeting TAOK1 with resveratrol inhibits esophageal squamous cell carcinoma growth in vitro and in vivo (PMID: 38376345)
biological.summary: TAOK1 is highly expressed in ESCC tumors and cell lines. Knockdown suppresses proliferation and PDX/CDX tumor growth, whereas overexpression promotes growth. Resveratrol binds TAOK1 directly and reduces its kinase activity, causing cell cycle arrest and apoptosis.

biological.citation: TAOK1 Promotes Proliferation and Invasion of Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer Cells by Inhibition of WWC1 (PMID: 36158126)
biological.summary: TAOK1 is increased in NSCLC cell lines and interacts with WWC1 by Co-IP. TAOK1 knockdown reduces invasion and proliferation and increases apoptosis, and WWC1 knockdown reverses these effects. TAOK1 knockdown also restrains xenograft growth in nude mice.
